correctness.rationale: For the fixed ordered alphabet 0<1<2 and n=13..30 only, the sharp BWT output words L are exactly those with adjacent unequal symbols, Hamming distance ceil(n/2) to sorted(L), and an n-cycle stable sorting permutation. Independently implemented two separate COMPLETE C++ enumerations of all 3*2^(n-1) such words for EACH n=13..30; one used parity pruning and one deliberately used NO pruning. Both give c_13..c_30=(28,4,88,22,120,30,256,61,540,94,1084,180,2148,330,3956,595,8322,1072); n=30 exhaustive generator visits 1,610,612,736 distinct candidates. Verified displayed witnesses with direct inverse and forward BWT and cyclic input runs; cited known factor-two lower bound gives U_q(n)=ceil(n/2) for all q>=3, limited to these n.
